text: ２ひき　までなら　あずかれるけど　もう　１ぴき　そだてて　みるかい？

structure.en: I can look after them, so

structure.jp: そだてて　みるかい？
structure.en: want to try having it raised?

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら means 'if it is that'. ２ひき　までなら = 'if it's up to two'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending means 'can do'. あずかれる = 'can look after'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means doing it to see how it goes. そだてて　みる = 'try raising'.
